---
title: "2 December — Individual research-design meetings"
description: "One-on-one meetings with the instructor"
---

The scheduled class period is used for individual meetings with the instructor about the final research design. There is no lecture, collective reading discussion, coding walkthrough or weekly recording.

## Book your meeting

Choose one appointment on **Wednesday 2 December** during the usual class period, **9:30 a.m.–12:15 p.m. Eastern**. The booking page will be linked here when the appointments open. Use your NYU email address. Your confirmation will contain the time and the individual video-meeting link; add it to your calendar.

If none of the available times works for you, contact the instructor directly to arrange another time. Each meeting is one-to-one, so please use the link in your own confirmation rather than another student's meeting link.

## Before we meet

Submit the [final research-design memo](../assessment.qmd#final-research-design-memo) **before your appointment begins**. Bring the memo and one concrete example of what your proposed LLM routine receives and returns.

Come prepared to discuss:

- the sociological question and contribution;
- the evidence or data the project would require;
- the precise role of the LLM;
- one concrete input → operation → output example;
- the most important validation problem;
- what should be emphasized in the presentation.

The meeting is developmental rather than separately graded. There is no additional coding submission for this date.
